parameters.formDescription: Enter client details and select the service. The system will auto-pull SOPs, deliverables, and timelines from your agency database and generate a complete onboarding package.

values.placeholder: e.g. Need a chatbot for our Shopify store that handles product queries, recommends items based on preferences, and captures leads. We get ~500 visitors/day.

parameters.jsCode:
const f = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  clientName: (f['Client Full Name'] || '').trim(),
  clientCompany: (f['Client Company Name'] || '').trim(),
  clientEmail: (f['Client Email'] || '').trim(),
  serviceRequired: (f['Service Required'] || '').trim(),
  clientRequirements: (f['Client Specific Requirements'] || '').trim(),
  budget: (f['Agreed Budget (INR)'] || '').trim(),
  startDate: (f['Desired Start Date'] || new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { year:'numeric', month:'long', day:'numeric' })).trim(),
  agencyName: (f['Your Agency Name'] || '').trim(),
  yourName: (f['Your Name'] || '').trim(),
  yourEmail: (f['Your Email'] || '').trim(),
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
}}];
